proposed_recovery.scope: Ordinary unload and reload of verified sgcard module affecting both bound TPU PCI functions
before_unload: Verify module checksum and running kernel
Recheck privileged fuser, accepting only exit 1 with empty output
Require module initstate live and reference count zero
Preserve logs and stop other new TPU launches
proposed_recovery.unload: rmmod sgcard, without force, bounded command and log capture
proposed_recovery.reload_condition: Unload returns zero, module and both PCI driver links are absent
proposed_recovery.reload: insmod verified module with card_num=64, two host CPUs, nice +10, bounded command and log capture
proposed_recovery.on_failure: Stop sequence, preserve output and inspect state; no force unload, retry loop or automatic reboot
proposed_recovery.after_reload: Read fresh initialization journal and device bindings before runtime/kernel diagnostics
